records.formula_source: Current Rayne Nutrition US product page and current first-party VC308M package nutrition/ingredient panel; older exact-size eBay product record used only as barcode evidence.
records.barcode_notes: eBay identifies the exact 24.2 lb Rabbit-MAINT dry dog food with GTIN-13/UPC representation 0013189409243. Standard leading-zero equivalence gives UPC-A 013189409243. The code is valid, but the barcode source is several years old and a current package image does not expose the barcode; current-generation barcode continuity is therefore not assumed.
conflicts: Rayne's live HTML ingredient renderer says both coconut oil and canola oil are preserved with mixed tocopherols; the current package panel places '(preserved with mixed tocopherols)' after canola oil only. The package panel is stored because physical label artwork outranks the HTML renderer.
verification_notes: UPC-A check digit verified: weighted sum for body 01318940924 is 97; expected check digit is 3.
Canonical GTIN-14 is UPC-A left-padded with two zeros: 00013189409243.
Repository-wide code search on 2026-08-30 found no occurrence of 013189409243 before append.

Current Rayne page still sells a 24.2 lb bag of this exact Rabbit-MAINT dry product; current package panel prints 3574 kcal/kg and 380 kcal/cup at 106 g/cup, plus 25% protein, 12% fat, 4% fibre, and 12% moisture.
Calorie cross-check: 3574 kcal/kg × 0.106 kg = 378.8 kcal, consistent with the printed 380 kcal/cup.

The current package states AAFCO nutritional levels for 'adult maintenance and growth'. No single repository life_stage value expresses that exact two-stage claim without broadening it to all life stages, so life_stage is null and the printed statement is preserved here.
A current physical bag/barcode image is required before promoting this barcode to source_verified.
